title: SkillOntologyContract
description: Design by Contract schema for OpenClaw skill ontology declarations. Skills declare which entity types they read/write and conditions they expect/guarantee.

skill_name.description: Skill identifier matching the skill directory name

reads.description: Entity types this skill reads from the ontology graph

writes.description: Entity types this skill creates or modifies in the ontology graph

preconditions.description: Conditions that must hold in graph.jsonl before skill can operate. Format: 'EntityType.property exists' or 'EntityType.property == value'

postconditions.description: Conditions guaranteed after skill execution. Format: 'EntityType.property is valid enum' or 'EntityType.property != value'
